% Checks a case the fix must not break: the current .aux and .bbl of a
% pdflatex and bibtex build beside the document, as latexmk leaves them.
% The first LaTeX run of the page's build reads that .bbl, gives no
% error, and writes its \bibcite lines, so LaTeX runs only twice.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Cited~\cite{fresh}.
\bibliographystyle{plain}
\bibliography{test-staleaux-bbl}
\end{document}
